name: 🥚EGGHUNT🐣 Stop it, Slender! 2
desc:
One player is chosen to be Slenderman every round, and the Citizens must collect all of his pages before they are taken..

Use code "freestuff" in Outfits for some complimentary Slender outfit items!

📄Get 5 bonus pages when you win your first Citizen round of the day!📄
🌀🕰️Want to experience classic versions of the game? Hop into the Time Portal!🕰️🌀
🎮Playable on all consoles, including VR! 🖥️

❕Private servers can pick the map and gamemode every round for free!
❕Players with Roblox Plus have access to one free lootbox every 20 hours.
❕Some gamepasses are not visible on this page, though you can purchase them via the in-game shop.

🎧Headphones are recommended.

🔦Having flashlight issues? Lower your graphics quality to level 1-4 to enable the lo-fi flashlight.
